'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Emil Wallin DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Typed onto the forum by AnakinSolo. Several locations and Effects are marked starting on that post (Wookiee Slaving Operation deploy).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
